title: Implement checksummed offline bundle packaging, staging, and missing artifact diagnosis
goal: Offline bootstrap requires packaging and importing checksummed bundles containing supported binaries, models, and extension metadata into isolated hosts, booting under network-disabled conditions, and diagnosing missing local artifacts without cloud fallback. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
